---
title: "Athletic Recovery — Sleep & Physical Strength"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(survey)
library(splines)
library(broom)
library(plotly)
library(jsonlite)
library(scales)

fmt1 <- \(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
fmt2 <- \(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
fmt_signed <- \(x, digits = 2) sprintf(paste0("%+.", digits, "f"), x)

# 1. Load preserved 10,987-row dataset (unmodified) + construct verified NHANES MEC design
df <- read_rds("data/processed/nhanes_sleep_strength.rds") |>
  mutate(
    sleep_cat_ref = relevel(sleep_category, ref = "Recommended (7-8h)"),
    sleep_bin_7 = case_when(
      sleep_hours <= 4 ~ "≤4h",
      sleep_hours == 5 ~ "5h",
      sleep_hours == 6 ~ "6h",
      sleep_hours == 7 ~ "7h",
      sleep_hours == 8 ~ "8h",
      sleep_hours == 9 ~ "9h",
      sleep_hours >= 10 ~ "10+h"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("≤4h", "5h", "6h", "7h", "8h", "9h", "10+h"))
  )

demo_mec <- bind_rows(
  read_xpt("data/raw/DEMO_G.XPT") |> select(SEQN, SDMVPSU, SDMVSTRA, WTMEC2YR),
  read_xpt("data/raw/DEMO_H.XPT") |> select(SEQN, SDMVPSU, SDMVSTRA, WTMEC2YR)
) |>
  filter(WTMEC2YR > 0) |>
  mutate(mec_weight_4yr = WTMEC2YR / 2) |>
  left_join(df |> select(-mec_weight_4yr) |> mutate(in_cohort = TRUE), by = "SEQN") |>
  mutate(in_cohort = coalesce(in_cohort, FALSE))

des_mec_full <- svydesign(
  id = ~SDMVPSU, strata = ~SDMVSTRA, weights = ~mec_weight_4yr,
  nest = TRUE, data = demo_mec
)
des_analytic <- subset(des_mec_full, in_cohort)
des_young <- subset(des_analytic, age >= 16 & age <= 44)

# 2. Young & Prime-Age Adult Cohort (Ages 16-44, n = 5,551) metrics
df_young <- df |> filter(age >= 16, age <= 44)
n_total <- nrow(df)
n_young <- nrow(df_young)
n_young_m <- sum(df_young$sex == "Male")
n_young_f <- sum(df_young$sex == "Female")
pct_young <- round(n_young / n_total * 100, 1)

# Survey-weighted regression in ages 16-44
m_svy_young <- svyglm(combined_grip_kg ~ sleep_cat_ref + sex * ns(age, df = 4), design = des_young)
td_young <- tidy(m_svy_young, conf.int = TRUE) |>
  filter(str_starts(term, "sleep_cat_ref")) |>
  mutate(cat = str_remove(term, "^sleep_cat_ref"))

y_6h <- td_young |> filter(cat == "Short (6h)")
y_5h <- td_young |> filter(cat == "Very Short (<=5h)")
y_9h <- td_young |> filter(cat == "Long (9+h)")

# 3. Hour-by-hour profiles in Ages 16-29 & 30-44 by Sex (Unweighted & Survey-Weighted, Combined & Max Single-Hand)
build_young_hourly <- \(metric_col) {
  fml <- as.formula(paste0("~", metric_col))
  svy_res <- svyby(
    fml, ~age_group + sex + sleep_bin_7,
    design = des_young, FUN = svymean, vartype = c("se", "ci")
  ) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    rename(w_mean = all_of(metric_col), w_lo = ci_l, w_hi = ci_u)

  unw_res <- df_young |>
    group_by(age_group, sex, sleep_bin_7) |>
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      u_mean = mean(.data[[metric_col]]),
      u_se = sd(.data[[metric_col]]) / sqrt(n()),
      u_lo = u_mean - qt(0.975, pmax(n() - 1L, 1L)) * u_se,
      u_hi = u_mean + qt(0.975, pmax(n() - 1L, 1L)) * u_se,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  unw_res |>
    left_join(svy_res, by = c("age_group", "sex", "sleep_bin_7")) |>
    mutate(
      age_group = as.character(age_group),
      sex = as.character(sex),
      sleep_bin = as.character(sleep_bin_7),
      bin_idx = match(as.character(sleep_bin_7), levels(df$sleep_bin_7)) - 1L,
      across(c(u_mean, u_lo, u_hi, w_mean, w_lo, w_hi), \(v) round(v, 1))
    ) |>
    select(age_group, sex, sleep_bin, bin_idx, n, u_mean, u_lo, u_hi, w_mean, w_lo, w_hi)
}

young_hourly <- list(
  cg = build_young_hourly("combined_grip_kg"),
  mg = build_young_hourly("max_hand_grip_kg")
)

# 4. Four-Model Stepwise Attenuation across full N = 10,987 (vs Recommended 7-8h)
m1_unadj <- lm(combined_grip_kg ~ sleep_cat_ref, data = df)
m2_sex <- lm(combined_grip_kg ~ sleep_cat_ref + sex, data = df)
m3_agesex <- lm(combined_grip_kg ~ sleep_cat_ref + sex * ns(age, df = 5), data = df)
m4_svy <- svyglm(combined_grip_kg ~ sleep_cat_ref + sex * ns(age, df = 5), design = des_analytic)

extract_sleep_coefs <- \(mod, mod_label, mod_type) {
  tidy(mod, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    filter(str_starts(term, "sleep_cat_ref")) |>
    transmute(
      model = mod_label,
      type = mod_type,
      category = str_remove(term, "^sleep_cat_ref"),
      est = round(estimate, 2),
      se = round(std.error, 2),
      lo = round(conf.low, 2),
      hi = round(conf.high, 2),
      pval = p.value
    )
}

model_comp <- bind_rows(
  extract_sleep_coefs(m1_unadj, "1. Unadjusted Sample OLS", "Descriptive"),
  extract_sleep_coefs(m2_sex, "2. Sex-Adjusted OLS", "Adjusted"),
  extract_sleep_coefs(m3_agesex, "3. Sex × Age-Spline OLS", "Adjusted"),
  extract_sleep_coefs(m4_svy, "4. NHANES Survey-Weighted GLM", "Survey-Weighted")
)

raw_5h_est <- model_comp |> filter(str_starts(model, "1."), category == "Very Short (<=5h)") |> pull(est)
raw_6h_est <- model_comp |> filter(str_starts(model, "1."), category == "Short (6h)") |> pull(est)
raw_9h_est <- model_comp |> filter(str_starts(model, "1."), category == "Long (9+h)") |> pull(est)
adj_9h_est <- model_comp |> filter(str_starts(model, "3."), category == "Long (9+h)") |> pull(est)
svy_9h_row <- model_comp |> filter(str_starts(model, "4."), category == "Long (9+h)")
svy_6h_row <- model_comp |> filter(str_starts(model, "4."), category == "Short (6h)")
svy_5h_row <- model_comp |> filter(str_starts(model, "4."), category == "Very Short (<=5h)")
attenuation_pct <- round((1 - abs(adj_9h_est / raw_9h_est)) * 100, 0)

rec_payload <- toJSON(
  list(
    meta = list(n_young_m = n_young_m, n_young_f = n_young_f),
    hourly = young_hourly,
    models = model_comp
  ),
  dataframe = "columns",
  auto_unbox = TRUE
)

dep_widget <- plot_ly() |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender("function(el) { el.style.display = 'none'; }")
```

<div class="platform-shell">

<!-- CHAPTER HEADER -->
<section class="hero-section" style="padding: 2.15rem 2.3rem;">
<div class="eyebrow-badge">
Chapter 1 &middot; Motivating Hypothesis &middot; Athletic Performance &amp; Recovery
</div>
<h1 class="hero-title" style="font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 3.4vw, 2.75rem);">
Does Habitual Short Sleep Erode <span class="gradient-text">Maximal Grip Strength</span>?
</h1>
<p class="hero-subtitle" style="margin-bottom: 1.1rem;">
Prior experimental reviews show that acute sleep loss (`&le;6h` in 24 hours) measurably reduces next-day exercise performance, particularly across prolonged, skill-intensive, and multi-set resistance sessions (<a href="about.html#references" style="color: #38bdf8; text-decoration: none;">Craven et al., 2022</a>; <a href="about.html#references" style="color: #38bdf8; text-decoration: none;">Knowles et al., 2018</a>). Motivated by that literature, we tested whether habitual short weekday sleep (`&le;5h` or `6h`) aligns with weaker isometric grip force in <strong>`r comma(n_young)` younger NHANES examinees (adolescents and prime-age adults, ages 16–44)</strong> and across all <strong>`r comma(n_total)` participants (ages 16–80+)</strong>.
</p>

<div class="rq-callout">
<div class="rq-label">Chapter 1 Analytical Takeaway</div>
<p class="rq-question">
Habitual short sleep (`&le;5h` and `6h`) shows no cross-sectional strength deficit relative to `7–8h` (`r fmt_signed(svy_6h_row$est)` kg for `6h`, `p = `r fmt2(svy_6h_row$pval)`` in survey-weighted models), while the observed raw `9+h` strength difference is attenuated by approximately `r attenuation_pct`% after accounting for sex and nonlinear age differences.
</p>
</div>
</section>

<div class="finding-note">
<strong>Distinguishing background exercise literature from this NHANES result:</strong> Systematic reviews of experimental sleep restriction find more consistent decrements in sustained, skill-demanding, or high-volume multi-joint resistance sessions than in brief, isolated maximal isometric tests (<a href="about.html#references" style="color: #38bdf8; text-decoration: none;">Knowles et al., 2018</a>; <a href="about.html#references" style="color: #38bdf8; text-decoration: none;">Craven et al., 2022</a>). Moreover, whereas laboratory trials induce acute sleep loss, NHANES captures <em>habitual self-reported weekday sleep</em> during a brief, 3-trial per hand isometric Takei dynamometer test (<a href="about.html#references" style="color: #38bdf8; text-decoration: none;">CDC/NCHS MGX Manual, 2013</a>). In our NHANES `16–44` analysis, `6h` sleepers match `7–8h` peers (`r fmt_signed(y_6h$estimate)` kg, `p = `r fmt2(y_6h$p.value)``). Notice also that men aged `30–44` exceed ages `16–29` across sleep tiers because adolescent males (`16–21`) are still gaining muscle mass.
</div>
</section>

wide_tab <- model_comp |>
  mutate(cell = paste0(fmt_signed(est), " kg [", fmt_signed(lo), ", ", fmt_signed(hi), "]")) |>
  select(model, type, category, cell) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = category, values_from = cell)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(wide_tab))) {
  r <- wide_tab[i, ]
  cat(paste0(
    "<tr>",

<div class="finding-note">
<strong>Interpreting statistical attenuation across the four models:</strong> In unadjusted sample data (Model 1), `&le;5h` and `6h` sleepers average `r fmt_signed(raw_5h_est)` kg and `r fmt_signed(raw_6h_est)` kg relative to `7–8h` sleepers, while `9+h` sleepers average `r fmt_signed(raw_9h_est)` kg. Model 2 (`+ sex`) accounts for sex differences in average strength, and Model 3 (`+ sex * ns(age, df = 5)`) accounts for nonlinear age differences across `16–80+`, attenuating the observed `9+h` difference by approximately `r attenuation_pct`% to `r fmt_signed(adj_9h_est)` kg. Finally, Model 4 incorporates NHANES 4-year MEC weights (`WTMEC2YR / 2`), strata (`SDMVSTRA`), and primary sampling units (`SDMVPSU`), yielding null population mean differences for short sleep (`&le;5h`: `r fmt_signed(svy_5h_row$est)` kg, `p = `r fmt2(svy_5h_row$pval)``; `6h`: `r fmt_signed(svy_6h_row$est)` kg, `p = `r fmt2(svy_6h_row$pval)``) and a modest `r fmt_signed(svy_9h_row$est)` kg (`p = `r sprintf("%.4f", svy_9h_row$pval)``) association for `9+h`. Note that covariate attenuation in cross-sectional models summarizes statistical adjustment and does not establish a causal mechanism.
</div>
</section>

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  let recMetric = "cg";
  let recEst = "w";

  const BINS = ["≤4h", "5h", "6h", "7h", "8h", "9h", "10+h"];

  function buildYoungSide(sexName, axisSuffix) {
    const tbl = REC_DATA.hourly[recMetric];
    const stages = [
      { ag: "16-29", label: "Ages 16–29", color: sexName === "Male" ? "#38bdf8" : "#f472b6", offset: -0.11 },
      { ag: "30-44", label: "Ages 30–44", color: sexName === "Male" ? "#2dd4bf" : "#c084fc", offset: 0.11 }
    ];

    return stages.map(st => {
      const xs = [];
      const ys = [];
      const errHi = [];
      const errLo = [];
      const cdata = [];
      const symbols = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < tbl.sex.length; i++) {
        if (tbl.sex[i] !== sexName || tbl.age_group[i] !== st.ag) continue;
        const m = recEst === "w" ? tbl.w_mean[i] : tbl.u_mean[i];
        const lo = recEst === "w" ? tbl.w_lo[i] : tbl.u_lo[i];
        const hi = recEst === "w" ? tbl.w_hi[i] : tbl.u_hi[i];
        const n = tbl.n[i];
        xs.push(tbl.bin_idx[i] + st.offset);
        ys.push(m);
        errHi.push(Number((hi - m).toFixed(2)));
        errLo.push(Number((m - lo).toFixed(2)));
        cdata.push([tbl.sleep_bin[i], n, lo.toFixed(1), hi.toFixed(1)]);
        symbols.push(n < 15 ? "circle-open" : "circle");
      }

      return {
        type: "scatter",
        mode: "markers",
        name: sexName + " · " + st.label,
        xaxis: "x" + axisSuffix,
        yaxis: "y" + axisSuffix,
        x: xs,
        y: ys,
        customdata: cdata,
        marker: {
          size: 9.5,
          symbol: symbols,
          color: st.color,
          line: { color: "#f8fafc", width: 1.5 }
        },
        error_y: {
          type: "data",
          symmetric: false,
          array: errHi,
          arrayminus: errLo,
          visible: true,
          color: st.color,
          thickness: 2,
          width: 5
        },
        hovertemplate:
          "<b>" + sexName + " (" + st.label + ") &middot; %{customdata[0]} Sleep</b><br>" +
          "Mean Grip: <b>%{y:.1f} kg</b> [95% CI: %{customdata[2]}–%{customdata[3]} kg]<br>" +
          "Subgroup Sample: n = %{customdata[1]}<extra></extra>"
      };
    });
  }

  function renderYoungHourly() {
    const mTraces = buildYoungSide("Male", "");
    const fTraces = buildYoungSide("Female", "2");
    const yTitle = recMetric === "cg" ? "Combined Bilateral Grip (kg)" : "Peak Single-Hand Grip (kg)";
    const yRange = recMetric === "cg" ? [35, 118] : [18, 62];

    const badge = document.getElementById("rec-hourly-badge");
    if (recEst === "w") {
      badge.className = "method-badge badge-weighted";
      badge.textContent = "NHANES Survey-Weighted Population Means (95% CI)";
    } else {
      badge.className = "method-badge badge-descriptive";
      badge.textContent = "Unweighted Sample Means (95% CI)";
    }

    const layout = {
      paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor: "rgba(8,13,26,0.72)",
      margin: { t: 52, r: 22, b: 68, l: 64 },
      font: { family: "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif", color: "#cbd5e1" },
      xaxis: {
        domain: [0, 0.47],
        range: [-0.55, 6.55],
        tickvals: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6],
        ticktext: BINS,
        title: { text: "Usual Nightly Sleep Hours (Males, Ages 16–44)", font: { size: 12, color: "#cbd5e1" } },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.10)",
        zeroline: false
      },
      yaxis: {
        range: yRange,
        title: { text: yTitle, font: { size: 13, color: "#f8fafc" } },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.12)"
      },
      xaxis2: {
        domain: [0.53, 1.0],
        anchor: "y2",
        range: [-0.55, 6.55],
        tickvals: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6],
        ticktext: BINS,
        title: { text: "Usual Nightly Sleep Hours (Females, Ages 16–44)", font: { size: 12, color: "#cbd5e1" } },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.10)",
        zeroline: false
      },
      yaxis2: {
        anchor: "x2",
        matches: "y",
        range: yRange,
        tickfont: { color: "#94a3b8" },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.12)"
      },
      annotations: [
        {
          xref: "paper", yref: "paper", x: 0.235, y: 1.07,
          xanchor: "center", yanchor: "bottom", showarrow: false,
          text: "<b style='color:#7dd3fc;font-size:13.5px'>AGES 16–44 MALES</b> <span style='color:#cbd5e1;font-size:12px'>(n = " + REC_DATA.meta.n_young_m.toLocaleString() + ")</span>"
        },
        {
          xref: "paper", yref: "paper", x: 0.765, y: 1.07,
          xanchor: "center", yanchor: "bottom", showarrow: false,
          text: "<b style='color:#f9a8d4;font-size:13.5px'>AGES 16–44 FEMALES</b> <span style='color:#cbd5e1;font-size:12px'>(n = " + REC_DATA.meta.n_young_f.toLocaleString() + ")</span>"
        }
      ],
      legend: { orientation: "h", x: 0, y: -0.17, font: { size: 11.5, color: "#e2e8f0" } }
    };

    Plotly.react("plot-young-hourly", mTraces.concat(fTraces), layout, {
      responsive: true,
      displaylogo: false
    });
  }

  function renderModelAttenuation() {
    const M = REC_DATA.models;
    const modelOrder = [
      "1. Unadjusted Sample OLS",
      "2. Sex-Adjusted OLS",
      "3. Sex × Age-Spline OLS",
      "4. NHANES Survey-Weighted GLM"
    ];
    const modelColors = {
      "1. Unadjusted Sample OLS": "#64748b",
      "2. Sex-Adjusted OLS": "#38bdf8",
      "3. Sex × Age-Spline OLS": "#2dd4bf",
      "4. NHANES Survey-Weighted GLM": "#a78bfa"
    };
    const catOrder = ["Very Short (<=5h)", "Short (6h)", "Long (9+h)"];
    const catLabels = ["≤5h Very Short\n(vs. 7–8h)", "6h Short\n(vs. 7–8h)", "9+h Long\n(vs. 7–8h)"];
    const offsets = [-0.21, -0.07, 0.07, 0.21];

    const zeroLine = {
      type: "scatter",
      mode: "lines",
      x: [-0.45, 2.45],
      y: [0, 0],
      line: { color: "rgba(248,250,252,0.55)", width: 1.6, dash: "dash" },
      hoverinfo: "skip",
      showlegend: false
    };

    const traces = [zeroLine];

    modelOrder.forEach((mName, mIdx) => {
      const xs = [];
      const ys = [];
      const hiArr = [];
      const loArr = [];
      const cdata = [];

      catOrder.forEach((cat, cIdx) => {
        for (let i = 0; i < M.model.length; i++) {
          if (M.model[i] === mName && M.category[i] === cat) {
            xs.push(cIdx + offsets[mIdx]);
            ys.push(M.est[i]);
            hiArr.push(Number((M.hi[i] - M.est[i]).toFixed(2)));
            loArr.push(Number((M.est[i] - M.lo[i]).toFixed(2)));
            cdata.push([cat, M.lo[i].toFixed(2), M.hi[i].toFixed(2), M.pval[i] < 0.0001 ? "<0.0001" : M.pval[i].toFixed(4)]);
          }
        }
      });

      traces.push({
        type: "scatter",
        mode: "markers",
        name: mName,
        x: xs,
        y: ys,
        customdata: cdata,
        marker: {
          size: mIdx === 3 ? 11.5 : 9.5,
          symbol: mIdx === 3 ? "diamond" : "circle",
          color: modelColors[mName],
          line: { color: "#ffffff", width: mIdx === 3 ? 2 : 1.2 }
        },
        error_y: {
          type: "data",
          symmetric: false,
          array: hiArr,
          arrayminus: loArr,
          visible: true,
          color: modelColors[mName],
          thickness: 2.2,
          width: 5
        },
        hovertemplate:
          "<b>" + mName + "</b><br>" +
          "Contrast: %{customdata[0]} vs. Recommended (7–8h)<br>" +
          "Difference: <b>%{y:+.2f} kg</b> [95% CI: %{customdata[1]} to %{customdata[2]} kg]<br>" +
          "p-value: %{customdata[3]}<extra></extra>"
      });
    });

    const layout = {
      paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor: "rgba(8,13,26,0.72)",
      margin: { t: 28, r: 24, b: 64, l: 72 },
      font: { family: "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif", color: "#cbd5e1" },
      xaxis: {
        range: [-0.45, 2.45],
        tickvals: [0, 1, 2],
        ticktext: catLabels,
        tickfont: { size: 12.5, color: "#f8fafc" },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.08)",
        zeroline: false
      },
      yaxis: {
        range: [-7.6, 3.6],
        title: { text: "Difference in Combined Grip vs. 7–8h (kg)", font: { size: 13, color: "#f8fafc" } },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.12)",
        zeroline: false
      },
      legend: { orientation: "h", x: 0, y: 1.12, font: { size: 11.5, color: "#e2e8f0" } }
    };

    Plotly.react("plot-model-attenuation", traces, layout, {
      responsive: true,
      displaylogo: false
    });
  }

  window.setRecMetric = function (m) {
    recMetric = m;
    document.getElementById("rec-metric-cg").classList.toggle("active", m === "cg");
    document.getElementById("rec-metric-mg").classList.toggle("active", m === "mg");
    renderYoungHourly();
  };

  window.setRecEst = function (e) {
    recEst = e;
    document.getElementById("rec-est-w").classList.toggle("active", e === "w");
    document.getElementById("rec-est-u").classList.toggle("active", e === "u");
    renderYoungHourly();
  };

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    renderYoungHourly();
    renderModelAttenuation();
  });
})();
</script>
```
